questions.question: You want to create a photo album but want exactly two pictures to appear on each slide. Where in the Photo Album dialog box must you make this adjustment?
questions.explanation: The Album Layout section contains the 'Picture layout' dropdown, which allows you to select the number of pictures per slide (e.g., '2 pictures').

questions.question: While creating a Photo Album, you have selected several files but want to change their order before finalizing the album. What is the immediate effect of clicking the up and down arrows below the 'Pictures in album' box?
options: It rearranges the pictures in the album
It changes the frame shape of the pictures
It previews the pictures in the pane
questions.explanation: The text states that you can rearrange the pictures by clicking the up and down arrows below the Pictures in album box.

questions.question: What is the exact sequence of tabs and groups required to access the 'New Photo Album' option in PowerPoint?
questions.explanation: To create a photo album, you must go to the Insert tab and under the Images group, select the New Photo Album option.

questions.question: If you want to use pictures stored locally on your computer for a Photo Album, which specific tab must be selected under the 'Insert picture from' section?
questions.explanation: The text explicitly instructs to choose the File/Disk tab under the Insert picture from section to pick images from your computer.

questions.question: Which feature allows multiple images to be displayed on a single slide in a Photo Album presentation, contrary to the default setting?
options: Enabling the Black and white option
questions.explanation: While the default setting is one picture per slide, you can include multiple images by adjusting the slide layout.

questions.question: In the Album Layout section of the Photo Album dialog box, what specific elements can be customized to change the appearance of your pictures?
options: Captions and Black and white settings
questions.explanation: The Album Layout section allows you to choose the picture layout and photo frame shape by clicking on the respective drop-down arrows.

questions.question: When inserting new pictures into a Photo Album, where does the selected picture appear once you click on it in the file browser?
options: In the Pictures in album box
questions.explanation: The text states that as you select the files, the preview of the picture gets displayed in the Preview pane.

questions.question: Which option in the Album Layout section allows you to apply a 'Rounded Rectangle' effect to your photos?
questions.explanation: The Frame shape dropdown menu allows you to select options like 'Rounded Rectangle' for the picture frames.

questions.question: What is the immediate consequence of clicking the 'Create' button in the Photo Album dialog box?
options: It saves the individual pictures to your hard drive
It generates the new photo album presentation
It inserts the pictures into the current slide
It deletes the selected pictures from the album
questions.explanation: Once all the pictures have been added and settings configured, clicking on the Create button generates your new photo album presentation.

questions.question: For which of the following scenarios is the Photo Album feature particularly useful according to the text?
options: Creating a slideshow for an organization where the main focus is pictures
Navigating between slides in any order during a presentation
questions.explanation: The text mentions that the Photo Album feature is useful for personal presentations or slideshows for organizations where the main focus is pictures.

questions.question: You are writing an equation using the Ink Equation feature and realize you made a mistake in a specific part of the equation. What is the recommended method to fix it without clearing the entire equation?
options: Use the Select and Correct option
questions.explanation: The Note section on Page 3 states that you can correct any part of the equation at any time by selecting the Select and Correct option from the Math Input Control dialog box.

questions.question: In the Math Input Control dialog box, what specific visual indicator appears on the light yellow grid area to show where writing will begin?
questions.explanation: The text states that when you bring the mouse pointer on the light yellow coloured grid area, a small black dot appears, which is the cursor.

questions.question: What is the correct sequence of UI elements to initiate the Ink Equation feature in PowerPoint?
options: Insert tab -> Media group -> Ink Equation
Draw tab -> Convert group -> Ink Equation
Insert tab -> Symbols group -> Equation dropdown -> Ink Equation
Draw tab -> Drawing Tools group -> Ink Equation
questions.explanation: To add Ink Equations, select the Insert tab, then in the Symbols group, click the drop-down arrow of the Equation button, and select Ink Equation.

questions.question: If you do not have a touch-enabled device connected to your system, can you still use the Ink Equation feature?
options: Yes, but only with a mouse
No, it requires a touch screen
Yes, using the keyboard arrow keys
questions.explanation: The text states that you can also use a mouse to write the equations if you do not have a touch device.

questions.question: What is the specific function of the Erase tool located in the toolbar of the Math Input Control dialog box?
options: To erase any part of the equation
To change the color of the ink
questions.explanation: The text states that you can select the Erase tool from the toolbar if you want to erase any part of the equation.

questions.question: After writing an equation in the Math Input Control dialog box and clicking the Insert button, what happens to the handwritten equation?
options: It is saved as a separate file
It is converted into a shape
questions.explanation: The text explains that PowerPoint converts the handwritten equations directly into text upon insertion.

questions.question: What is the name of the specific dialog box that appears when you select the Ink Equation option?
questions.explanation: The text explicitly states that the Math Input Control dialog box appears when you select the Ink Equation option.

questions.question: A user wants to record a webinar but needs to ensure their voice is captured clearly. Which of the following hardware components is NOT explicitly mentioned as required in the text for this task?
questions.explanation: The text lists a sound card, microphone, and speakers as necessary for recording sound, but does not mention a webcam.

questions.question: During a screen recording session in PowerPoint, which shortcut key combination must be used to stop the recording?
questions.explanation: The Countdown dialog box indicates that the shortcut key combination to stop recording is Windows + Shift + Q.

questions.question: What specific dialog box appears immediately after you click the Record button to start a screen recording?
questions.explanation: The text states that a Countdown dialog box appears, indicating that recording is going to start in a few seconds.

questions.question: How can you record only a specific portion of your screen instead of the full screen during a screen recording?
options: Click the Select Area button and drag the mouse
Click the Record button and press Alt
Use the Zoom tool to define the area
Change the slide layout before recording
questions.explanation: To record a specific area, you must click on the Select Area button and then drag the mouse to highlight the desired screen region.

questions.question: Where does the recorded screen video go after you click the Stop button to save the recording?
options: It is saved to the Desktop
It is inserted into the current slide
It is added to the Slide Master
It is copied to the clipboard
questions.explanation: The text notes that the recorded screen video will get inserted into the current slide.

questions.question: After a screen recording is inserted into a slide, which tab appears on the ribbon to allow you to add special effects to the video?
questions.explanation: The text states that you can add special effects to the video by using the special Playback tab that appears on the ribbon.

questions.question: What is the exact path to access the Screen Recording option in PowerPoint?
questions.explanation: To use the Screen Recording feature, click on the Insert tab and select the Screen Recording option from the Media group.

questions.question: If you want to include sound in your screen recording, what specific option must you enable in the Screen Recording pop-up window?
questions.explanation: The text states that you can turn on the Audio option if you want to insert sound in your screen recording.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid reason mentioned in the text for using the Screen Recording feature?
questions.explanation: The text lists creating a tutorial, recording a game session, and capturing a webinar as reasons for screen recording. Creating a photo album is a separate feature.

questions.question: During a screen recording, the pop-up window disappears. What specific action must you take to make it visible again so you can stop the recording?
options: Bring the mouse pointer to the top of the screen
questions.explanation: The text instructs that when you are done, bring the mouse pointer to the top of your computer screen to show the pop-up window again.

questions.question: To convert a hand-drawn shape into a uniform geometric shape using the Draw tab, what specific action must be performed on the 'Ink to Shape' option?
options: Drag and drop it onto the shape
questions.explanation: The text explicitly states to click on the Ink to Shape option twice from the Convert group.

questions.question: If PowerPoint fails to recognize a hand-drawn shape and cannot convert it into a geometric shape, what is the outcome?
options: The drawing is converted into a text box
The drawing is replaced with a default circle
questions.explanation: A Note on Page 5 states that if a drawing does not match any geometric shape, the drawing remains unaffected.

questions.question: Where are the Pen, Pencil, and Highlighter options specifically located within the PowerPoint interface?
questions.explanation: To write notes, you select the Draw tab and click on any of the Pen options from the Drawing Tools group.

questions.question: What is the precise sequence of steps to delete an annotation using the Eraser tool in PowerPoint?
options: Select Eraser tool -> Move over annotation
Select Eraser tool -> Click drop-down arrow -> Choose eraser type -> Move over annotation
Select Eraser tool -> Press Delete key
questions.explanation: The text outlines the steps: Select the Eraser tool, click the drop-down arrow of the Eraser option to choose the type, and then move the eraser over the text or drawing.

questions.question: During a presentation in Slide Show view, which tools can be used to annotate or highlight key points according to the 'Let's Know More' section?
options: Annotation pen, highlighter, or laser pointer
Ink Equation, Ink to Shape, or Ruler
Slide Zoom, Quick Access Toolbar, or Define
questions.explanation: The Let's Know More section states that in Slide Show view, you have the option to use the annotation pen, highlighter, or laser pointer.

questions.question: How can you change the ink color or thickness of a pen while using the drawing tools?
options: Right-click the pen and select Properties
Click the drop-down arrow of the selected pen
questions.explanation: The text states that to change the ink color or thickness of the pen, you click on the drop-down arrow of the selected pen.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the Ink Annotation feature in PowerPoint?
options: To write notes, create shapes, and highlight key concepts
To add math equations to the presentation
To navigate between slides in any order
questions.explanation: The text describes Ink Annotation as a feature that enables you to annotate with ink to write notes, create shapes, highlight a key concept, and much more.

questions.question: Which specific tool in the Drawing Tools group is used to highlight text on a slide?
questions.explanation: A Note on Page 5 states that you can highlight the text by using the Highlighter tool from the Drawing Tools group on the Draw tab.

questions.question: How does the Slide Zoom feature improve the flow of a presentation compared to standard navigation methods?
options: It allows navigation between slides in any order without interrupting the flow
It automatically records the presentation for later viewing
It converts handwritten notes into text during the presentation
It allows you to create a photo album on the fly
questions.explanation: The Slide Zoom feature allows you to navigate between slides in any order and can be done without interrupting the flow of your presentation.

questions.question: What is the exact sequence of UI elements to access the Slide Zoom option in PowerPoint?
options: View tab -> Zoom group -> Slide Zoom
Draw tab -> Convert group -> Slide Zoom
questions.explanation: To use the Slide Zoom option, you click on the Insert tab and then click on the Zoom button in the Links group.

questions.question: After selecting slides in the Insert Slide Zoom dialog box and clicking Insert, how do these selected slides appear on the current slide?
questions.explanation: The text states that the selected slides will appear in the form of thumbnails on the slide where you have inserted them.

questions.question: When playing a slide show that includes Slide Zoom, what specific action triggers the zoom effect for a particular slide?
questions.explanation: The text explains that during the slide show, you click on the slide's thumbnail that you want to zoom in on.

questions.question: In which view mode does the Slide Zoom feature specifically work?
questions.explanation: The text notes that this feature works in the slide show mode only.

questions.question: What is the name of the dialog box that opens when you initiate the Slide Zoom process?
questions.explanation: The text states that the Insert Slide Zoom dialog box opens when you select Slide Zoom.

questions.question: What is the quickest way to exit a slide show presentation according to the 'Let's Know More' section?
questions.explanation: The Let's Know More section on Page 5 states that to quit the slide show, you press the Esc key on the keyboard.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a valid way to move to the next slide during a slide show presentation?
questions.explanation: The text lists clicking the left mouse button, Enter, Spacebar, or Down Arrow key to move to the next slide. It does not mention the right mouse button.

questions.question: How can you add a frequently used command to the Quick Access Toolbar in PowerPoint?
options: Double-click the tool on the ribbon
Right-click the tool and select Add to Quick Access Toolbar
Drag and drop the tool onto the toolbar
questions.explanation: The Let's Know More section states that to add any tool to the Quick Access Toolbar, you must right-click on the tool or command and select the Add to Quick Access Toolbar option.

questions.question: According to the textbook's exercise section, which tab contains the definition and pronunciation of the selected text?
questions.explanation: This question is taken directly from the textbook's exercise section on Page 7, which indicates that the Define tab provides definitions and pronunciations.

questions.question: According to the textbook's exercise section, which group contains the Ink to Shape option?
questions.explanation: The exercise section on Page 8 confirms that the Ink to Shape option is found in the Convert group.

questions.question: According to the textbook's exercise section, on which tab do you find the Screen Recording option?
questions.explanation: The exercise section on Page 8 confirms that the Screen Recording option is found on the Insert tab.

questions.question: True or False: You cannot add sound while doing the screen recording.
options: Only if you have a webcam
Only if you are recording a game session
questions.explanation: The statement is false because the text explicitly states that you can turn on the Audio option if you want to insert sound in your screen recording.

questions.question: True or False: The Lasso Select tool is used to select objects.
questions.explanation: The exercise section on Page 8 confirms that the Lasso Select tool is used to select objects.

questions.question: True or False: You cannot correct any part of the equation after you finish writing it using Ink Equation.
options: Only if you used a mouse
Only if you didn't click Insert
questions.explanation: The statement is false because the Note section on Page 3 states that you can correct any part of the equation at any time by selecting the Select and Correct option.
